Alliances Spoiler Starter Decks

💧🔵 BLUE STARTER DECK – RHA'VELKOR, TRIBAL CHIEF 🔵💧

The Lizardfolk of Glimmertal have lived alongside powerful Arcane Mages for generations. While other races must study magic for years, the ancient power of Water Magic flows through the Lizardfolk by pure instinct.

They are led by Rha'Velkor, Tribal Chief, the Sovereign of the Blue faction. Through his ancient power, he grants his followers an additional action, allowing them to strike again, reposition themselves, or protect themselves with magical shields against enemy attacks. Control the battlefield through clever tactics, powerful spells, and the disruption of your opponent's plans.

✅ 60-card deck – ready to play
✅ Perfect for new and experienced players alike
✅ Includes 6 exclusive cards available only in this Starter Deck
⭐ Special Highlight: Spell Disruptor is available in the main set exclusively as a Collector Edition card!

Master the flow of magic, outmaneuver your opponents, and lead the tribes of Glimmertal to victory under the command of Rha'Velkor, Tribal Chief.

🔥🔴 RED STARTER DECK – GRAK'NAR, THE BLOODRAGE 🔴🔥

The hordes of the Red Realm march to war. Orcs, Ogres, and Goblins sweep across the lands of Leros, led by their ruthless Sovereign, Grak'Nar, The Bloodrage. Wherever his armies appear, they leave behind scorched earth, shattered fortresses, and chaos. A raging firestorm will spread across Leros—and no one will be able to stop it.

Grak'Nar embodies the raw strength and unstoppable fury of his Horde. Warriors of the Red faction possess the Horde ability. Fighting together as one, they grow stronger with every additional Horde character on the battlefield. What begins as a small warband quickly grows into an overwhelming army that buries its enemies beneath a relentless wave of attacks.

The Red Starter Deck focuses on aggressive gameplay, powerful warriors, and the constant expansion of your Horde. Crush your opponents before they can establish their defenses and unleash the full wrath of Grak'Nar.

✅ 60-card deck – ready to play
✅ Perfect for new and experienced players alike
✅ Includes 5 exclusive cards available only in this Starter Deck
⭐ Special Highlight: Zura, Keeper of the Oaths is available in the main set exclusively as a Collector Edition card!

Let us talk about this Deck in our Discord

🧵🟣 PURPLE STARTER DECK – MYRALIN WINDBLADE 🟣🧵

Deep within the mysterious Realm of Threads, perhaps the most magical region in all of Leros, everything is woven together by invisible magical threads. These ancient strands connect places, creatures, and destinies, forming a vast network of power and secrets. Here dwell the Fairies—graceful and highly magical beings who have maintained their neutrality for centuries.

They are led by Myralin Windblade, Sovereign of the Realm of Threads. Long ago, the Fairies swore never to take sides in the conflicts of Leros. But dark omens are spreading across the world. The signs of Leros' destruction grow stronger each day, and even the magical threads themselves have begun to tremble.

Unlike the other races of Leros, Fairies possess far less life force. Instead, they rely on their magic and form powerful Alliances with their protectors. Through these sacred bonds, they gain protection, strength, and new ways to outmaneuver and control their opponents.

The Purple Starter Deck focuses on clever combinations, magical synergies, and the unique Alliance mechanic. Forge powerful bonds, manipulate the battlefield, and unleash the hidden power flowing through the magical threads.

✅ 60-card deck – ready to play
✅ Perfect for new and experienced players alike
✅ Includes 5 exclusive cards available only in this Starter Deck

🪨🟤 BROWN STARTER DECK – KRADOR, SOVEREIGN OF STONE AND SOIL 🟤🪨



Deep within the rugged lands of Brronmark dwell mighty Golems, primal humans, and creatures born from stone and earth. At their head stands Krador, Sovereign of Stone and Soil, a colossal Stone Golem brought to life by the most precious gemstone in all of Leros: Lerium.

Lerium is the source of Krador's power and the foundation of the Brown faction's strength. With every Lerium reserve you secure, your army grows stronger. Small warriors become towering colossi, mighty constructs rise from the ground, and your forces transform into an unstoppable force of nature.

The Brown Starter Deck focuses on resource growth and ever-expanding armies. Increase your Lerium reserves, summon gigantic creatures, and overwhelm your opponents with sheer size, resilience, and ancient power.


Harness the power of Lerium, command the ancient strength of stone and soil, and lead Krador's colossal army to reshape the fate!
